title: Sunday Pocket
description: A funk track in E dorian, 104 BPM, 104 bars (about 4:00): sampled acoustic drums with ghost snares, bass guitar, muted funk guitar, comb-pluck keys, drawbar organ (rotary slow in the verses, fast in the climax) and horn stabs. Intro, verse, pre, hook, verse, break, organ solo, final hook, outro. Drums need the kit download (Load kit, 31 MB); without it there are no drums. Not listened to.
